notes.zh-CN: Trae 现在可以把图片发给支持识图、且提供商能接收图片的模型（如 MiMo V2.6 Flash/Pro）；Google 等无法转发图片的提供商仍会拒绝。文件变更面板可从左下角调整大小。手机端在同步断开后会刷新登录并重连，对话标题更清楚地显示在线与进行中状态。macOS 为 universal 包，未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 沿用历史 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: Trae can now send images to vision models whose provider can carry them, including MiMo V2.6 Flash and Pro. Providers that cannot forward images, such as Google, still refuse them. The changed-files panel can be resized from the bottom-left corner. The mobile app refreshes its sign-in and reconnects after the sync connection drops, and the conversation header shows online and in-progress state more clearly. macOS is a universal build and is not notarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The APK retains its previous debug signing identity. The IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
